cards.name: GPT
cards.spotColor: Purple in the eyes and gemstone
cards.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the attached approved AITI GPT engraved collectible card front, making exactly one change: redraw ONLY the ivory dragon within the existing circle as a more abstract restrained engraving, a heraldic dragon made of a few spacious broad shapes, plus a handful of repeated motifs. Work directly over the original drawing and pose-lock every landmark. Retain everything outside the character untouched: the exact 2:3 canvas, dark navy textured paper hue, original ivory ink hue, original straight outer border and corner diagrams, compass circle, visible existing negative space, full positions and original lettering contours of BEYOND CONTEXT, AITI, GPT, and the exact existing unfolded engineering sheet. Do not redesign or shift anything. Do not add elements.
Trace the original dragon silhouette closely. Same size, same low broad front three-quarter crouch, lowered angular head and narrowed eyes, exact original horn and broad raised double-wing silhouettes, all existing paw positions, the front paw planted on the exact same engineering sheet, and the same tail arcing around the right flank and pointing back down to the plan. Same knot, purple diamond, tassel and small purple eyes, simplified to their clearest shapes, in the same spots. Preserve the exact large overlap boundaries between head, wings, feet, torso and tail. The exterior silhouette should be virtually identical to the source.
Inside the dragon, remove nearly ALL of the micro-hatching and small scale outlines. Reduce interior mark density by roughly 75%. Compose the main head, neck and haunch as generous calm unbroken ivory fields, with a few navy contour cuts or shallow inset curves. On a few surfaces only, place sparse groups of 2 to 4 large, precise engraved lozenges or chevrons that follow the turn of the form, rather than wrapping the whole body in scales. In each wing show only the sweeping outline and two or three elegant tapered ribs, with wide uninterrupted negative-space areas. Use weight and clean negative-space shapes to show the crouch, rather than illustrative shading. A small handful of wider engraving strokes on the entire character suffice to echo the original hand-printed feeling. Keep the original subtle tooth of the ink and original navy ground in the cutouts, so the simplified dragon feels printed with the existing border. The finished center should read instantly at actual card size. Aim between a seal and an engraving: still recognizably the exact same character and same approved card, but quieter, more symbolic and notably less intricate. Do not render it as a cartoon or smiling mascot. Return a single full-bleed card front.

cards.name: DeepSeek

cards.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Create one flat 2:3 portrait AITI collectible card front, as another card in this SAME printed set. Image 1 is the approved final GPT front and the exact card template to edit. Image 2 is the previous DeepSeek card, for character design and pose only, and reference for its exact name lettering. Preserve the ENTIRE frame of image 1: same dark Prussian-navy subtle cardstock texture over all background, same warm ivory ink, identical outer border and right-angle circuit corner ornaments, compass circle with four ivory markers, proportions, and same positions and exact two lines of BEYOND CONTEXT top left and AITI top right. Reuse template wordmark shapes. Do not borrow the city or bright pale disk from image 2. Do not change global color, zoom, border, logo or frame placement. Replace ALL of the GPT dragon and engineering plan from the circular center with only the character and the original props from image 2. Replace the bottom-left 'GPT' with exactly 'DeepSeek' at the same left edge and baseline and same weight, following the corresponding text in image 2. Preserve spelling and case. 
Pose and props: The exact plump orca-like whale from image 2, rising diagonally from lower left to upper right with the same two little flippers, leftward forked tail, upward gaze, head shape, large pale belly and oval cheek patch, and the original three small bubbles above its face at upper right. Capture the same round proportions. Lay out the white underside and cheek patch in large ivory forms; suggest the originally blue back using navy negative space bounded by an unbroken broad ivory contour and one or two calmly curved ivory shapes. Keep the eyes small and the bubbles subordinate. No water or other objects.
Render the EXACT gesture, viewing angle, shape proportions, facing direction and main props from image 2. Fit the entire character and props comfortably inside the circle, well spaced around it, with the same overall optical scale and center position as the approved GPT card. Stylization is identical to the GPT on image 1: large clean warm-ivory filled shapes, deep navy negative-space cuts, just a handful of tapered detail strokes, a sparse group of rhythmic geometric details where useful. Same subtle textured ink as GPT; neither a 3D render nor a busy line drawing. Make it a legible, mature, print-like carved emblem with decisive sans-serif-like shapes and little or no crosshatching. The navy-and-ivory contrast remains dominant, as in image 1. Spot color: clear ocean blue / turquoise in the irises and a small bubble highlight only. Color should be comparable in area to the approved GPT purple eye-stone accents, or at most 2 percent of the card. No tinted card backgrounds, colored borders, colored typography, lighting gradient, additional text, added decorative elements or mockup. Output one complete rectangular card face.
